newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Beijing Holding closes US$50 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Beijing Holding closes US$50 mln loan.

text.p: Beijing Holding Co Ltd's US$50 million term loan facility has been allotted, arranger Bank of Communication said on Monday.
The borrower owns 69 percent of Beijing Enterprises Holdings Ltd.
The facility has a final maturity of one year. It pays an interest margin of 70 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
Fees are 20 basis points for lead managers committing US$8 million, 15 basis points for senior managers committing US$5 million, and 10 basis points for managers committing US$3 million.
Bank of Communication Hong Kong is the arranger.
Bank of East Asia, HypoBank and Sakura Bank are lead managers.
ABN Amro Bank and DBS Bank are senior managers.
BNP Hong Kong and IBJ Hong Kong are managers.
